name: CSS-Only Snap Carousel
description: A swipeable, paginated carousel with prev/next buttons and dot markers built with zero JavaScript via scroll-snap plus the new ::scroll-button and ::scroll-marker pseudo-elements.
usage: Copy styles.css into your project and mark up a .snap-carousel wrapper containing a .snap-carousel__track list with one .snap-carousel__slide per item (see index.html). The browser generates the prev/next buttons and dot pagination automatically — no scripts, no extra markup.
